quests.title: A Lone Ship In Guyun

dialogue.t: You're... the Traveler? What are you doing here!?
Looking around? You think you can waltz in here and look at whatever you please — you know what this place is?
Hmph! Forget it, it's pointless... Oi, someone get over here! Tie up this busybody and feed 'em to the fishies!
Alright, what's all the ruckus? You pretending to be important when Beidou's not around again?
This troublemaker snuck in here — presumably up to no good — and I thought I would just deal with this for Beidou...
Alright, stop scaring people. If Beidou found out you were just tying up anyone who came in, you'd be the one being dealt with.
B—But this troublemaker should pay for sneaking onto the ship, right?
Our ship isn't just for people to come and go as they please.

dialogue.sit: Yes, I must answer for my crimes.
How should I make it up to you?

dialogue.t: See!? Even the troublemaker agrees.
Hmm, I have an idea... Beidou has anchored the ship here while she goes into the city for business.
We can't leave the ship without her orders, and the rest of the fleet is on patrol at sea, so they can't help us now...
But some of the crew has errands in the city that they haven't been able to run. If you really want to make it up to us, go around the ship and see who needs help.
You seem to be quite interested in our ship anyway, so explore a bit while you're helping out.
You're... the Traveler? What are you doing here!?
Looking for the Captain? Does she look like she's someone you just come "looking for" as you please?
Oi, someone get over here! Tie this stowaway up and feed 'em to the fishies!
Alright, alright, what's all the ruckus?
This troublemaker snuck in here. Said they're looking for... Well, they're up to no good, I'll wager — and I thought I would just deal with this for Beidou...
Alright, stop scaring people any old how, or Captain Beidou'll scold you upside down.
Uhh... I...
Alright. Off you go, cool your head. Now then, Traveler, what business might you have with the Captain?

dialogue.sit: I'd like to go to Inazuma.

dialogue.t: You want to go to Inazuma? By ship?
Hmm... You'd best see the Captain herself about this. She's on board right now.
But it seems that she's been deep in thought recently. Keep your eyes open and try not to disturb her.
*sigh* We've also been anchored here for quite a while due to her orders, which has led to quite a few delays.
If you're willing, why don't you go around the ship and see who needs help?
Where could Beidou be off to...?
Ah, it's you! So you actually did go around the ship helping people...
Well I gotta job for you. We just pulled into shore, so we haven't had time to restock on food.
Out on the open sea for so long eating dried meat every day, it eats away at one's heart. It's not everyday we're near port, we best get some fresh food.
But I don't know where Beidou is at, and the rest of the crew isn't to leave the ship. It'd be great if you could bring us some Fowl or Raw Meat.
So eager... Okay, I'll leave it to you then.
*sigh* When will we finally be able to go into the city...?
Ah, it's you! So you really are going around the ship helping people...
Well I gotta job for you. We just pulled into shore, so we haven't had time to restock on food.
Out on the open sea for so long eating dried meat every day, it eats away at one's heart. It's not everyday we're near port, we best get some fresh food.
If you're fine with it, it'd be great if you could bring us some Fowl or Raw Meat.
So eager... Okay, I'll leave it to you then.
We want to eat something different now that we have the chance. I'll leave it to you then! Remember — Fowl or Raw Meat.
Did you bring any meat back?
Hmm, we can make steak out of this, perfect to pair with a drink. Beidou will surely be pleased.
Hmm, we can make steak out of this, perfect to pair with a drink.
Wow, this is great! We can grill a lot of skewers of meat with this. When Beidou gets back, she'll have some nice food to chow down on with her drink.
Wow, this is great! We can grill a lot of skewers of meat with this.
Huh!? Looks like you forgot what I told you... If I wanted to eat Fish, I could've just caught it myself!
Forget it, it's edible at the very least... However, Beidou will still need some meat to go with her drink when she gets back...
Huh!? Looks like you forgot what I told you... If I wanted to eat Fish, I could've just caught it myself!
Well, whatever, I guess we can eat it, at least...
When will we finally be able to get off the ship...?
Eh? You're... the one who snuck onto the ship, right? I could hear Uncle Juza yelling from halfway across the ship.
Did Uncle Juza frighten you? Hehe, relax. He's a good person, he was just trying to act tough and scare you a bit.
But... when will we finally be able to go into the city? While Beidou is busy doing stuff in Liyue Harbor, Uncle Juza won't let us leave the ship.
Aunt Yinxing had promised to take me shopping in the city, and then I could go play with Changchang.
Last time, I told Changchang I would play with her when I got back, but now...
You should still be able to go into the city, right? Can you help me out?
Find some Starconches for me on the shore. I think... three will be enough.

dialogue.sit: What do you want Starconches for?

dialogue.t: Thank you! I really appreciate it.
When will we finally be able to get off the ship...?
Eh? You're... the one who snuck onto the ship, right? I could hear Uncle Juza yelling from halfway across the ship.
Did Uncle Juza frighten you? Hehe, relax. He's a good person, he was just trying to act tough and scare you a bit.
Still, I wonder when we'll finally be able to go into the city...
Aunt Yinxing had promised to take me shopping in the city, and then I could go play with Changchang.
Last time, I told Changchang I would play with her when I got back, but now...
You should still be able to go into the city, right? Can you help me out?
Find some Starconches for me on the shore. I think... three will be enough.

dialogue.sit: What do you want Starconches for?

dialogue.t: Thank you! I really appreciate it.
When will we finally be able to go into the city...?
Did you find the Starconches?
Thank you! Wait a sec while I fiddle with these...
Aunt Yinxing taught me how to make a toy out of Starconches. Hmm, the next step is...
Little Yue isn't back yet, is he?

dialogue.sit: This is a gift from Little Yue.

dialogue.t: Little Yue is back!? Then why didn't he come over himself?
Last time he said he would come play with me, but it's been forever...

dialogue.sit: He can't leave the ship now.

dialogue.t: Okay... He said the same thing the time before last, when a big, tall man brought me a gift from him.
Nothing he can do about it, I guess. I'm sure it's all because of Beidou again.
But thank you anyway for the gift. Please thank Little Yue for me as well.
When my daddy comes back, I'll ask him to take me to the ship Little Yue is on.
If he can't come here, I can at least go to him — hmph!
I hope Changchang enjoys that toy...
There, all done! Can you please take this to Changchang for me?
I really want to give it to her myself, but... Beidou probably won't be coming back soon.
And even when she does come back, we might just set straight out to sea again.
*sigh* It doesn't seem like I'll be able to make it into the city this time. I hope Changchang won't get mad...
There, all done! Can you please take this to Changchang for me?
I really want to give it to her myself, but it looks like we won't be able to make it into the city this time. I hope Changchang won't get mad at me...
Did you give my present to Changchang?

dialogue.sit: She is going to come see you.

dialogue.t: That's good. Thanks for your help.
Little Yue hasn't come play with me in forever — he's so annoying!
Did you give my present to Changchang?

dialogue.sit: She is going to come see you.

dialogue.t: That's good. Thanks for your help.
Did Juza frighten you? Don't take it personally, he's just like that.
He also speaks a bit loudly on account of his poor hearing... but he's really a good person at heart.
Okay, so if you aren't busy, think you can help me with something?
It's been so long since we've returned to shore, but Juza is making everyone stay on the ship until Beidou gets back.
Last time I was in the city, I paid Bolai to buy some supplies in advance for when I returned.
Take this letter to Bolai, and he'll get someone to bring the supplies to the ship.
Thank you.
Did Juza frighten you? Don't take it personally, he's just like that.
He also speaks a bit loudly on account of his poor hearing... but he's really a good person at heart.
Okay, so if you aren't busy, think you can help me with something?
Last time I was in the city, I paid Bolai to buy some supplies in advance for when I returned.
But since it doesn't look like we'll be going to the city any time soon, take this letter to Bolai, and he'll get someone to bring the supplies to the ship.
Thank you.
It's been a long time. Why hasn't anyone come...?
So now you're delivering the letter... What about the guy from last time? He's not with you, is he?
Phew, that's good... Okay, the supplies are all ready, I'll get someone to take them over in a bit.
Guyun Stone Forest... That's a long way, I will probably need to hire a boat to get there.
Yinxing's last payment should be enough to cover it though...
The money I paid him last time should be enough.
But we still need to get new clothes for Little Yue. He's grown out of his old ones.
When will we finally be able to go into the city...?
Did you deliver the letter?
Thank you for your help, otherwise I would've had to ask Juza to deliver it again.
He'd only scare Bolai, then Juza'd have to come back and drag me over anyway to explain the situation to Bolai...
When Bolai brings the supplies over, I'll pay him for next time as well.
Just in case we can't leave the ship the next time we return to port either...
Whew, Guyun Stone Forest is a looong way from the city...
Who are you? How'd you get on the ship?
What do you want? Hmph, if you're trying to rob me, think again.
Get out of here fast, or you'll be sorry.
Huh... Judging by your clothes, I'd say you're the Traveler, right? What are you doing on the ship?
You just came to help? Well I don't need any.
You should get out of here. You can't just come onto the ship as you please.
Agh! Where'd you come from!? I didn't see you...
I don't have anything you can help with. You should go back to wherever you snuck up on me from.
Stirring up trouble on this ship won't do you any good.
Who're you? You don't seem like one of the crew.
...I don't need your help with anything. If you aren't one of the crew, and you weren't invited, then I suggest you leave.
Otherwise, someone may make you leave.
...Haven't seen you before. You aren't one of the crew, are you...?
It's been a long time since a stranger came on the ship.
I won't ask any random stranger for help. You should leave.
You lent a hand to so many people on the ship, I lost track.
I'm curious, how did you get so good at helping people?

dialogue.sit: I help people solve problems for a living.

dialogue.t: Hmph, "traveling around"? ...I'm sure there's more to it than that, but I won't press you.
Take these. Consider it thanks for helping us out.
Well, you're forgiven for sneaking onto the ship. No harm came of it anyway.
But remember if you board the ship in the future, do it properly.
Alright, you can go now. I have some work on the ship to take care of.
As soon as we returned from Inazuma, Beidou had us anchor the ship here while she went into Liyue Harbor.
But she's been gone for so long now, it's not good to just be stuck here by Guyun Stone Forest.
I should go into the city and look for her...
You lent a hand to so many people on the ship, I lost track.
I'm curious, how did you get so good at helping people?

dialogue.sit: I help people solve problems for a living.

dialogue.t: Hmph, "traveling around"? ...I'm sure there's more to it than that, but I won't press you.
Take these. Consider it thanks for helping us out.
We should have something nice to eat.
I really want to give it to her myself, but... Beidou probably won't be coming back soon.
And even when she does come back, we might just set straight out to sea again.
*sigh* It doesn't seem like I'll be able to make it into the city this time. I hope Changchang won't get mad...

quests.description: A heavily armed ship of unknown origins has stopped outside Guyun Stone Forest. You hop right on board to investigate…
